title: BM$^2$: Coupled Schrödinger Bridge Matching
tldr_zh: 前后向漂移互为 bridge-matching 目标、单网络单循环 SGD 求 SB；完全极小化时等价 I-BM/DIPF，部分极小化只证不动点
tldr_en: Forward and backward drifts regress on each other's bridge mixtures in one SGD loop; full minimization recovers I-BM/DIPF, partial minimization only has SB as fixed point.
key_numbers: cBW2-UVP at eps=0.1: BM2 0.73/4.64/6.84/8.28 vs I-BM 1.07/4.25/7.19/16.63 (Table 2); LightSB-M reports 0.02/0.1/0.56/1.32 on same benchmark
eps=10, d=128: BM2 264.4, I-BM 578.7, DIPF 226.1 vs independent coupling 4.45 and discretized true SB 10.48 (Table 2)
Single 3-layer x768 MLP (~1M params), 50k steps, batch 1000, EM 200 steps (Sec. 5)
